title: Standard Cleaning
shortDescription: Recurring upkeep for clean, comfortable everyday spaces.
overview: Best for homes and apartments that need consistent maintenance rather than a full reset.
includedItems: Kitchen counters, sink, appliance exteriors, and surfaces.
Bathrooms, mirrors, fixtures, tubs, showers, and toilets.
Dusting reachable surfaces and high-touch areas.
Vacuuming, sweeping, mopping, and trash removal.
Bed making and light room straightening on request.

title: Deep Cleaning
shortDescription: A detailed reset for buildup, neglected zones, and seasonal refreshes.
overview: Deep cleaning is ideal before recurring service, after busy seasons, or when a home needs extra attention.
includedItems: Everything in standard cleaning.
Baseboards, cabinet fronts, door frames, switches, and handles.
Detailed bathroom descaling and kitchen degreasing.
Extra attention to corners, edges, fixtures, and buildup.
Optional oven, fridge, cabinet, window, laundry, and bedding add-ons.

title: Move-In and Move-Out Cleaning
overview: Support for empty homes, apartments, rental turnovers, leases, listings, and final walkthroughs.
includedItems: Kitchen, bathroom, room, closet, and floor cleaning.
Cabinet interiors when empty and accessible.
Baseboards, switches, doors, fixtures, and vents.
Inside oven and inside fridge available as add-ons.
Rental turnover and property manager coordination on request.

title: Office Cleaning
shortDescription: Reliable cleaning for focused, professional workplaces.
overview: Office cleaning plans for small businesses, studios, clinics, and shared workspaces.
includedItems: Reception areas, desks, conference rooms, and common spaces.
Restroom cleaning and supply restocking where requested.
Kitchenette and breakroom surfaces.
Trash removal, vacuuming, sweeping, and mopping.
Custom recurring schedules for business hours or after-hours service.

question: How do you determine pricing?
answer: Pricing is based on your home size, current condition, service type, frequency, and add-ons. Pricing is based on average condition. Excessive buildup, heavy soil, pet hair, clutter, biohazard conditions, or neglected spaces may require additional labor charges.
